Barrientos, Manuel (Vicar General and acting Archbishop)
A.L.S. and Ms. D.S. 2pp. sm. fol. 1772.
Dispensation of publishing the banns for marriage of two Spaniards "to avoid scandle!" The woman's first husband had been dead but a few months, and the man was the headclerk of her business.
